before.hypothesis: Compact TM0 research-taste priors will improve same-model frontier selection and discovery efficiency.
before.falsifier: No improvement or worse causal closure / closed-loop cost against baseline.

after.worldModelUpdate: Correct research sayings are not an operational research policy; added meta-representation can create deliberation/search overhead.

before.hypothesis: Two literal searches derived only from explicit owner-evidence handles will contract the source frontier enough to improve same-budget causal localization.
before.falsifier: No success/cost improvement across Harness and materially different Security holdout.

after.worldModelUpdate: Conditional operator selection is a stronger operational candidate for research taste; both holdouts had 2/2 required-file seed coverage and combined success improved 3/6 to 5/6.

before.hypothesis: Exact symbolic/source pressures are retrieval-dominated enough that deterministic compilation plus one semantic synthesis can replace iterative discovery.
before.falsifier: A materially different exact-symbol holdout needs adaptive semantic relation following despite matching required files.

after.worldModelUpdate: Harness localized diagnostics are compilation-friendly; Security distributed representation/dataflow is not. Research operator choice must be conditioned on causal/evidence topology, not exact-symbol presence alone.

before.hypothesis: TM4 topology-conditioned operator policies transfer to fresh Host and Runtime owner pressures.
before.falsifier: Selected operator fails to improve semantic acceptance/causal score, or wrong operator is not detectably harmful on a materially different holdout.

after.worldModelUpdate: RFM1 gained fresh OOD support. RFM2 retained directional value because compiled wrong false-stopped 3/3 and adaptive relation-following improved mean causal score, but selected adaptive success only 1/3 prevents treating it as a reliable policy.

before.hypothesis: Before each observation, explicit live alternatives/current decision/discriminator/predicted decision change will let the Agent stop when no affordable decision-changing observation remains.
before.falsifier: No reduction in observation consumption, premature false stops, or quality gains that require exhausting the same evidence ceiling.

after.worldModelUpdate: All four cells averaged 32/32 observations. Explicit marginal-value narration may improve causal quality, but stopping requires a different representation/operator. High budget is capacity rather than evidence obligation.

before.hypothesis: Progressive Agent-controlled inspection of six Game evidence windows can stop before full reveal while preserving the full-evidence semantic target.
before.falsifier: Progressive uses the full evidence universe, costs more than full bounded synthesis, or diverges from stable full-evidence references.

after.worldModelUpdate: 8/8 consumed 6/6 windows, progressive matched full references only 6/8, and selection cost about 2.3x matched one-shot tokens. Batched/non-serial stopping is the next candidate only when full inspection is materially expensive.
